messages:
camille: Quick heads-up — tiny agenda change: runtime roadmap moved from 11:00→11:10 to 11:10→11:40. Q&A moves to 11:40. Please read.
matt_oss: I can moderate the Q&A, compile questions in #all-hands-qna doc.
anya: Slides updated in Drive: https://drive.redwood/internal/runtime-roadmap (final slide deck v3). Will trim to fit 25 mins.
camille: Thanks @matt_oss @anya. Also need an AV/streaming check — last week's recording dropped frames. Anyone from infra on standby?
infra-bot: [automated] Scheduled stream relay: us-east-1-relay-3, expected bandwidth 5mbps.
grace: FYI my OBS test had CPU spikes on the test VM earlier. Lowering canvas to 720p fixed it. Recommend doing a quick test at 11:02.
paul_ops: Legal approved recording and upload to internal S3. Need to confirm retention settings (30d vs 90d) — @lina?
lina: Legal confirmed 30d for all-hands recordings. For exec-level content we'll mark separately. Security audit team looped in.
camille: Great. @paul_ops can you run permission check and start recording at go? I'll cue speakers.
matt_oss: I'll start the Q&A doc and drop the two flagged questions from product + one from eng-ml.
anya: Note: trimming runtime deck to 25 min — cutting slide 8 deep-dive, keeping appendix for questions.
grace: I'll do a dry-run at 11:03 and post a short clip here. If anyone else is remote pls join to verify audio.
paul_ops: Will confirm perms at 11:05 and flip the recording toggle. Also reducing recording bitrate to avoid drops.
deploy-bot: [reminder] Canary deploy of console assets at 11:30 — might cause brief artifact loading for slides.
camille: Ack, thanks. Anyone hosting remote watch party link? I'll post Zoom + stream link at 11:08.
matt_oss: Quick ask — can we collect live questions in Slido? I can create a room unless we prefer slack threads.
lina: Slido is fine; product team requested preserve anon option.
anya: Slido link added to deck notes.
infra-bot: [automated] Pre-stream healthcheck passed: relay latency 48ms, available encoders 4/4.
grace: posted 20s test clip — audio looks OK on my end. @camille can you confirm you can hear the clip?
camille: Heard it fine. One more mic sweep at 11:02 and we should be green.
paul_ops: Recording started.
camille: Awesome. Once we wrap runtime, we'll do the 15-min open Q at 11:40. If people have run-over questions, drop them into the Slido and I'll prioritize.
matt_oss: I'll pin top 5 to the doc during the talk.
anya: If timing gets tight, I'll skip the implementation TODOs slide and defer to follow-up doc.
camille: Perfect. See you all in 8 mins — please be by your mics. :thumbsup:
